# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.7.4

Candidate only; no GitHub Release or website deployment has been requested.

Adds Seedance 2.5 Flash (480p/720p) and Seedream 5.5 (1K/1.5K/2K) to the shared 24-model CLI/MCP/workflow catalog. Seedance 2.5 supports ordinary 4K and 480p draft conversion to 1080p or 4K. Flash does not support drafts or draft conversion. Quotes remain backend-owned.

Draft-final reuse requires the same known resolution. Mismatched or unknown resolutions stop with the existing task ID. Concurrent reuse and workflow recovery retain known tasks and never label a 1080p result as successful 4K or retry automatically.

Skill resources are version 1.0.3, requiring CLI 0.7.4. Model-specific material rules and examples are synchronized. SHA-256 verified candidate installers and local bundles preserve existing configuration, workflows and submission history. Windows continues to use native DPAPI; native Windows/Linux CI and live generation remain unverified for this candidate.

Source contract evidence separately pins Generate main and the scoped Seedance 4K branch. Branch support is not proof of production deployment. Audio 1.5 and video upscale remain deferred. Existing publication and real-person acceptance gates remain pending.
